We expect to expand our expertise, and our acquisition focus, outside our traditional vertical approach to other precision measurement solutions, including in the fields of measurement of force, weight, pressure, torque, tilt, motion, and acceleration.
We believe acquired businesses will benefit from improvements we implement to reduce redundant functions and from our current global manufacturing and distribution footprint.
Research and development (“R&D”) will continue to play a key role in our efforts to introduce innovative products to generate new sales and to improve profitability.
We expect to continue to expand our position as a leading supplier of precision foil technology products.
We are realizing the benefits of our restructuring through lower labor costs and other operating expenses and expect to continue reaping these benefits in future periods.
We are evaluating plans to further reduce our costs by consolidating additional manufacturing operations.
While streamlining and reducing fixed overhead, we are exercising caution so that we will not negatively impact our customer service or our ability to further develop products and processes.

The Company believes that its current cash and cash equivalents, credit facilities and projected cash from operations will be sufficient to support its working capital requirements, capital expenditures and strategic initiatives for the foreseeable future.
The Company will continue to evaluate its cash needs, however we currently do not intend, nor do we foresee a need, to repatriate funds in excess of what is already planned.

Cash paid for property and equipment for the nine fiscal months ended October 3, 2026 was $10.6 million compared to $5.0 million in the comparable prior year period, and primarily was due to investments in manufacturing equipment to support the increase in volume, automation initiatives and capacity expansion projects across the Company's operations.
These investments are intended to support long-term revenue growth, improve operating leverage and enhance the Company's competitive position in its end markets.
